cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader, expanding the reader's table access from the default schema to all tables in database r0. Experiment comparison shows: baseline loaded_entries=99 → candidate loaded_entries=198 (2x increase). worker-runtime max_entries=200 (row_id: w-h9c5/setting/worker-runtime.max_entries). The 198 loaded entries operate at 99% of the 200-entry limit, leaving only 2 entries of headroom. The meta-store rows_visible_to_builder also doubled from 99 to 198, confirming the grant expanded query scope. While 198 < 200 technically stays under the limit, the proximity is concerning.
